verdict.rationale: Ghostty ships an official first-party library, libghostty, a cross-platform, zero-dependency C and Zig library for building terminal emulators or embedding terminal functionality. Its libghostty-vt component is described as usable today on macOS, Linux, Windows and WebAssembly. However, the evidence frames only libghostty-vt as available now, so the broader library's readiness is unclear. It is also an embedding and terminal-emulation library rather than an SDK for programmatically driving Ghostty, and it is limited to C and Zig. Missing for 10: confirmed general availability of the full libghostty, SDK reference documentation/API docs, bindings for mainstream languages (e.g. Python/TypeScript), an SDK for controlling a running Ghostty instance, independent hands-on corroboration.
